title: Packers expect Luke Musgrave to recover from his neck injury and play this season

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Packers expect Luke Musgrave to recover from his neck injury and play this season
sources.description: The Packers put tight end Luke Musgrave on the reserve/physically unable to perform list to start the season, but they believe he'll be on the field before the season is over.
